claims.claim: Mango wall hair dryer for salons.
claims.evidence: Photos 0 and 1 show a Mango branded hair dryer hood with a salon-style wall mount.

claims.claim: 6 months of use / bought new last year.
claims.evidence: No receipt or date-stamped documentation is visible in the report.

claims.claim: Very perfect condition / No fault at all.
claims.evidence: The witness did not see the device powered on or heating.
Internal inspection or close-up of factory seals is required to verify if the motor housing has been tampered with.
These documents were not captured in the witness report.

risks.risk: Heating element may be burnt out or inconsistent.
risks.proof: A video clip showing the dryer powered on with a thermometer inside the hood showing a temperature rise.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a non-heating unit/fan only.

risks.risk: Fan motor may be seized, weak, or excessively noisy.
risks.proof: A video with clear audio showing the fan spinning at all speed settings.

risks.risk: The articulated wall arm may be loose or unable to support the weight of the hood.
risks.proof: A video showing the arm being moved through its full range of motion and staying in place.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a hood only, assuming the mounting hardware is scrap.

risks.risk: Internal hood damage or melting from previous overheating.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the interior of the dryer hood.

proof_requests: Video of the device powered on, demonstrating both the fan and heating functions.
Photos of the receipt and warranty card mentioned by the seller.
Close-up photo of the interior of the hood.
Photo of the power cord and plug to check for burns or repairs.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a Mango wall-mounted hair dryer. It can be priced at a worst-case functional value until the heating and motor operations are proven.
